#!/bin/sh
# This script was generated using Makeself 2.2.0

umask 077

PACKAGEARCH="x86_64"
CURRENTARCH=$(uname -m)
CRCsum="3977356495"
MD5="33db57ecd3920ec8051cf66cca29140b"
TMPROOT=${TMPDIR:=/tmp}

label="huorong installer"
script="./inst.sh"
scriptargs="00_linux_client_v2_amd64_server"
licensetxt=""
targetdir="linux_package_20_amd64"
filesizes="22457794"
keep="n"
quiet="n"
export instcmdline="$0 $*"

print_cmd_arg=""
if type printf > /dev/null; then
    print_cmd="printf"
elif test -x /usr/ucb/echo; then
    print_cmd="/usr/ucb/echo"
else
    print_cmd="echo"
fi

# environment pre-check
root_chk=y
arch_chk=y
arch_list="x86_64 aarch64 loongarch64 mips64el mips64 mips64le"
glibc_chk=y
disk_chk=n
disk_inst_path="/usr/local"
disk_needs=$(( 2 * 1024 * 1024 ))
tools_chk=y
tools_list="tar" # separator is ' '
inst_chk=n
inst_path="/usr/local/huorong"
arch_name=$(uname -m)

glibc_ver=
if [ $arch_name = "x86_64" ]; then
	glibc_ver=2.12
elif [ $arch_name = "aarch64" ] || [ $arch_name = "mips64el" ] || [ $arch_name = "mips64" ] || [ $arch_name = "mips64le" ]; then
	glibc_ver=2.17
elif [ $arch_name = "loongarch64" ]; then
	glibc_ver=2.28
fi

Copyright()
{
	# need completed
	echo
}

MS_Print_Done()
{
	printf "[1;32m$1[0m
"
}

MS_Print_Error()
{
	printf "[1;31m$1[0m
"
}

unset CDPATH
install="y"
if test "$PACKAGEARCH" != ""; then
	install="n"
	for arch in $PACKAGEARCH
	do
		if test "$CURRENTARCH" = "$arch"; then
			install="y"
			break
		fi
	done
fi

if test $install = "n"; then
	echo "($PACKAGEARCH) File Unsupported $(uname -m) CPU architecture Install."
	exit 1
fi

MS_Printf()
{
    $print_cmd $print_cmd_arg "$1"
}

MS_PrintLicense()
{
  if test x"$licensetxt" != x; then
    echo $licensetxt
    while true
    do
      MS_Printf "Please type y to accept, n otherwise: "
      read yn
      if test x"$yn" = xn; then
        keep=n
 	eval $finish; exit 1
        break;
      elif test x"$yn" = xy; then
        break;
      fi
    done
  fi
}

MS_diskspace()
{
	(
	if test -d /usr/xpg4/bin; then
		PATH=/usr/xpg4/bin:$PATH
	fi
	df -kP "$1" | tail -1 | awk '{ if ($4 ~ /%/) {print $3} else {print $4} }'
	)
}

MS_dd()
{
    blocks=`expr $3 / 1024`
    bytes=`expr $3 % 1024`
    dd if="$1" ibs=$2 skip=1 obs=1024 conv=sync 2> /dev/null | \n    { test $blocks -gt 0 && dd ibs=1024 obs=1024 count=$blocks ; \n      test $bytes  -gt 0 && dd ibs=1 obs=1024 count=$bytes ; } 2> /dev/null
}

MS_dd_Progress()
{
    if test "$noprogress" = "y"; then
        MS_dd $@
        return $?
    fi
    file="$1"
    offset=$2
    length=$3
    pos=0
    bsize=4194304
    while test $bsize -gt $length; do
        bsize=`expr $bsize / 4`
    done
    blocks=`expr $length / $bsize`
    bytes=`expr $length % $bsize`
    (
        dd bs=$offset count=0 skip=1 2>/dev/null
        pos=`expr $pos \+ $bsize`
        MS_Printf "     0%% " 1>&2

#!/bin/bash
# Copyright 2017 gRPC authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#     http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

set -ex

# cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../.."
cd $2

# Install openssl (to use instead of boringssl)
# apt-get update && apt-get install -y libssl-dev
export INSTALL_DIR=$3/install
export OPENSSL_DIR=$6

# 1.46.5 version cannot be compiled by gcc-4.8. by lizhuo
export PATH=/usr/bin:$PATH
export CC=$2/gcc-4.9.4/bin/gcc
export CXX=$2/gcc-4.9.4/bin/g++
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -fPIC -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections"
export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$2/gcc-4.9.4/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH

# Use externally provided env to determine build parallelism, otherwise use default.
# GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS=${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS:-4}

# Install absl
rm -rf "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install c-ares
rm -rf "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCARES_STATIC=ON -DCARES_SHARED=OFF ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install protobuf
rm -rf "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF ..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install re2
rm -rf "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install zlib
rm -rf "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Just before installing gRPC, wipe out contents of all the submodules to simulate
# a standalone build from an archive
# shellcheck disable=SC2016
# git submodule foreach 'cd $toplevel; rm -rf $name'

# Install gRPC
rm -rf "cmake/build"
mkdir -p "cmake/build"
pushd "cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" \n  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 \n  -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR \n  -DOPENSSL_ROOT_DIR=$OPENSSL_DIR \n  -DZLIB_ROOT=%INSTALL_DIR% \n  -DgRPC_INSTALL=ON \n  -DgRPC_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \n  -DgRPC_ABSL_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_CARES_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_PROTOBUF_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_RE2_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_SSL_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_ZLIB_PROVIDER=package \n  ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# # Build helloworld example using Makefile and pkg-config
# pushd examples/cpp/helloworld
# export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/grpc/lib/pkgconfig
# export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/grpc/bin
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}"
# popd

# # Build route_guide example using Makefile and pkg-config
# pushd examples/cpp/route_guide
# export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/grpc/lib/pkgconfig
# export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/grpc/bin
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}"
# popd

@ECHO OFF
PUSHD .

SET SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set JAVA_CMD=%UNM_ROOT%\platform\jre in\java
set JAVAW_CMD=%UNM_ROOT%\platform\jre in\javaw

CD "%SCRIPT_DIR%\.."
FOR /F %%I IN ('CD') DO SET ROOT_DIR=%%I

FOR /F %%I IN ('TYPE "%ROOT_DIR% in\jarfile"') DO SET PACKAGE_NAME=%%I
set MAIN_CLASS=com.fiberhome.service.TelemetryServiceEntry
echo %MAIN_CLASS%
TITLE %PACKAGE_NAME%
if "%1" neq "" (
  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -DExtYmlUrl="%1" -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"
) else (
  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%" 
)
exit
::CALL java -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"

POPD

#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR="$( cd -- "$( dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" )" &> /dev/null && pwd )"


cd $SCRIPT_DIR

NMTOOLS_DIR=$SCRIPT_DIR/..
AGNET_DIR=$NMTOOLS_DIR/unm_cm_agent
SERVICE_DIR=$NMTOOLS_DIR/unm_cm_service
NGINX_DIR=$SERVICE_DIR/thirdparty/nginx
chmod 777 $NMTOOLS_DIR/scripts/chmod_nmtool.sh
sh $NMTOOLS_DIR/scripts/chmod_nmtool.sh

cd $NMTOOLS_DIR
if [ ! -f $NMTOOLS_DIR/unm2000install.ini ];
then 
	echo $NMTOOLS_DIR/unm2000install.ini exist
else 
	echo $NMTOOLS_DIR/unm2000install.ini not exist
fi
cp -R $NMTOOLS_DIR/arm/python $AGNET_DIR
cp -R $NMTOOLS_DIR/arm/nginx $SERVICE_DIR/thirdparty


#注册cmagent服务
cd $AGNET_DIR
sh set_nmtool_var.sh
cd $AGNET_DIR/bin
sh install_nmtool_agent.sh

#注册cmservice服务
cd $SERVICE_DIR/bin
#chmod -R 777 install_nmtool_service.sh
sh install_nmtool_service.sh

#nginx
cd $NGINX_DIR/bin
#chmod -R 777 install_nmtool_webservice.sh
sh install_nmtool_webservice.sh

#开机自启
systemctl daemon-reload

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
@ECHO OFF
PUSHD .

SET SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set JAVA_CMD=%UNM_ROOT%\platform\jre in\java
set JAVAW_CMD=%UNM_ROOT%\platform\jre in\javaw

CD "%SCRIPT_DIR%\.."
FOR /F %%I IN ('CD') DO SET ROOT_DIR=%%I

FOR /F %%I IN ('TYPE "%ROOT_DIR% in\jarfile"') DO SET PACKAGE_NAME=%%I
set MAIN_CLASS=com.fiberhome.ai.alarm.cusa.StartUp
echo %MAIN_CLASS%
TITLE %PACKAGE_NAME%
if "%1" neq "" (
  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -Xmx4096m -DExtYmlUrl="%1" -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"
) else (
  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -Xmx4096m -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"
)
exit
::CALL java -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"

POPD

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
@echo off

set server_ip=%1
set server_user=%2
set server_pwd=%3
set install_path=%4
set cusaplatform_user_dir=%5
set cusaplatform_root_path=%~d0
set cusaagent_folder=CusaDeployAgent
echo "cusaplatform_root_path is: " %cusaplatform_root_path%
echo "cusaplatform_user_dir is: " %cusaplatform_user_dir%

cd /d %~dp0
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform	hirdparty
set local_folder=%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\%cusaagent_folder%_win
:: set remote_folder=\10.170.90.218\D$\CusaDeployAgent
set remote_folder=\%server_ip%\%install_path%$\%cusaagent_folder%
echo "local_folder path: " %local_folder%
echo "remote_folder path: " %remote_folder%
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform\log
set log_file_path=%cusaplatform_user_dir%\log
echo %cd%
echo "-----set args finished!-----"

:: if exist %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log del %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log /f /s /q /a
if exist %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log del /F /S /Q %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log

if not exist %local_folder% (
    echo "error: %local_folder% not exist"
    echo "%local_folder% not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user%
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo " error: net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail"
    echo "net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----connect successed!-----"

if exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "%remote_folder% is exist, call stop.bat and delete %remote_folder%"
    %cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\WMIC.exe /node:%server_ip% /user:%server_user% /password:%server_pwd% process call create "cmd /c %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%\service\stop.bat"
    ping %server_ip% -n 30 >nul
    rd /S /Q %remote_folder%
)


xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% is fail"
    echo "xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
if not exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "error: %remote_folder% is not exist"
    echo "%remote_folder% is not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
echo "-----xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% finished!-----"


if exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip% (
    rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
) else (
    md %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
)
CALL %local_folder%\service\create-cusaagentxml.bat %server_ip% %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%
if not exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml (
    echo "error: create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail"
    echo "create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

if exist %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml del /S /Q %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml /f /s /q /a

copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml to \%server_ip%\%4$\CusaDeployAgent\service\ is fail"
    echo "%local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml to \%server_ip%\%4$\CusaDeployAgent\service\ is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ /delete
echo "-----delete connect successed!-----"

%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\WMIC.exe /node:%server_ip% /user:%server_user% /password:%server_pwd% process call create "cmd /c D:\CusaDeployAgent\service\start.bat"
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    set error_msg="call start.bat is fail"
    echo %error_msg%
    echo %error_msg%>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----install cusaagent successed!
exit /b 0

:ERROREXIT
exit /b 1

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

#current_path=$(dirname $(readlink -f $"0"))
#thirdparty_path=$(dirname $(dirname $current_path))/thirdparty
#定时任务是通过cron.service文件执行的，当前目录变更为根目录了，所以这里采取在安装nginx的时候记录nginx的路径
nginx_home=$(cat /usr/nginx_home)
days=7
LOGS_PATH=$nginx_home/logs
 
NEWLOGS_PATH=$LOGS_PATH/history

if [ ! -d "$NEWLOGS_PATH" ];then
	mkdir $NEWLOGS_PATH
fi
 
YESTERDAY=$(date -d "yesterday" +%Y%m%d)
 

mv ${LOGS_PATH}/access.log ${NEWLOGS_PATH}/access_${YESTERDAY}.log
 
/bin/kill -SIGUSR1 $(cat $nginx_home/nginx.pid)

find $NEWLOGS_PATH/ -mtime +$days -delete
